verses: Woh turush roo hua aur mun mor liya
(sirf uss liye) kay uss kay pass aik nabina aaya
Tujhay kiya khabar shayad woh sanwar jata
Ya naseehat sunta aur ussay naseehat faeedah phunchati
Jo bey perwahi kerta hai
Uss ki taraf to to poori tawajja kerta hai
Halankay uss kay na sanwarney say tujh per koi ilzam nahi
Aur jo shakhs teray pass dorta hua aata hai
Aur woh darr (bhi) raha hai
To uss say byrukhi baratta hai
Yeh theek nahi Quran to naseehat (ki cheez) hai
Jo chahaye uss say naseehat ley
(yeh to) per azmat saheefon mein (hai)
Jo buland bala aur pak saaf hai
Aisay likhney walon kay hathon mein hai
Jo buzurg aur pakbaz hai
Allah ki maar insan per kaisa nashukra hai
Ussay Allah ney kiss cheez say peda kiya
(ussay) aik nutfay say, phir andaza per rakha uss ko
Phir uss kay liye raasta aasan kiya
Phir ussay maut di aur phir qabar mein dafan kiya
Phir jab chahaye ga ussay zindah ker dey ga
Hergiz nahi. Uss ney abb tak Allah kay hukum ki baja aawari nahi ki
Insan ko chahaiye kay apney khaney ko dekhay
Kay hum ney khoob pani barsaya
Phir phaara zamin ko achi tarah
Phir uss mein say anaj ugaye
Aur angoor aur tarkari
Aur zaitoon aur khajoor
Aur gunjaan baghaat
Aur mewa aur (ghaas) chara (bhi ugaya)
Tumharay isteymaal o faeeday kay liye aur tumharay chopayon kay liye
Pus jab kay kaan behray ker denay wali (qayamat) aajaye gi
Uss din aadmi apney bhai say
Aur apni maa aur apney baap say
Aur apni biwi aur apni aulad say bhagay ga
Unn mein say her aik ko uss din aisi fikar (daman geer) hogi jo uss kay liye kafi hogi
Uss din boht say chehray roshan hun gay
(jo) hanstay huye aur hashash bashash hun gay
Aur boht say chehray uss din ghubaar aalood hun gay
Jin per siyahi charhi hui hogi
Woh yehi kafir badkirdar log hun gay
